mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_order ( order_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, total_amount, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, close_time, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{sessionId}, #{ticketCategoryId}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{payTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{closeTime}, #{cancelReason}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, total_amount, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, close_time, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, total_amount, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, close_time, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, total_amount, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, close_time, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, total_amount, status, expire_time, pay_time, cancel_time, close_time, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_order WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_time < #{now} ORDER BY expire_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order SET status = #{newStatus}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{oldStatus}
UPDATE ticket_order SET status = #{newStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{oldStatus}
UPDATE ticket_order SET status = #{newStatus}, close_time = #{closeTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{oldStatus}
